name: cx-box
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` does not require pickup afterward; it allows carrying the box before the fall to satisfy the rule. The task says to pick it up again whenever it falls. Use `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` only if the proposition semantics make it enforce a later pickup; here `holding_box` can already be true on the fall step? No: a fall empties the hands, so this response does require carrying on a later step. The clauses correctly capture that requirement. However, `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` is satisfied only by carrying on the last step, as `at_exit` is true only then. All clauses match the task; no correction is needed.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires carrying the box when reaching it, and Response(box_fell, holding_box) requires carrying it again after every fall.

texts: Reach the exit while carrying the box.
Be carrying the box when reaching the exit.
Whenever the box falls, carry it again afterward.
